description: Allowlisted exceptions for audit rules. Keyed by rule slug; values are substrings matched against finding.file or finding.message. test-files: ported from legacy tools/audit-cli/test-audit-exceptions.json at cutover (P6.2). doc-links: (1) `.etc/powershell/.env` and `.claude/settings.local.json` are gitignored by design, so every reference to them is correct yet never resolves in a clean checkout such as CI; (2) `docs/ai/plans/tools-review-and-standardisation.md` is the ledger of the 2026-09 tools/ renames and cites the pre-rename paths on purpose; (3) `docs/ai/plans/new-surfaces-orchestration.md` (status: complete) and the P6.2 completion row of `docs/ai/plans/audit-cli-rebuild.md` record the tree as it stood when that work was done (rewriting any of these would falsify the record); (4) `artifacts/` is gitignored by design (review evidence emitted by tooling), so links from the temporal plans to `artifacts/reviews/...` are correct yet never resolve in a clean checkout; the three `Reference "artifacts/...` entries match only the quoted link target in a finding message, so a broken reference to any other path inside a file that merely mentions artifacts still fails; (5) `docs/ai/plans/temporal-00-program.fable-council-transcript.md` is a verbatim council transcript whose quoted spec names read as bare paths — rewording it would falsify the record; (6) the remaining `Reference "..."` entries each match one historical quotation exactly: `audits/gate.log` is an explicitly mistyped log path quoted verbatim in `docs/ai/plans/temporal-orchestration.md`; `audit-cli/spec.md` is a shortened spec path in `temporal-final-fable-acceptance-2.md`; `PineGuard.Core/MustClauses/MustValidatorCast.cs` is a nonexistent path quoted from a stale agent-memory note in `temporal-u0-fable-closure.md`; the `t1-u4-guardclauses-coverage-20260927/manifest.json` link text in the u4 commit proposal and receipt names an archived artifact (its link target is covered by clause (4)); and the extra `artifacts/temporal/`, `artifacts/code-coverage/` and `artifacts/fable-final-acceptance-2026-09-26.stream.jsonl` entries are further gitignored tooling output cited by the temporal plans — all of these records are verbatim and rewording them would falsify them. A new broken reference in any other file still fails the gate.
